verdict.rationale: The first-party README states llama.cpp ships custom CUDA kernels for NVIDIA GPUs, AMD support via HIP and Moore Threads via MUSA, plus Metal for Apple silicon. That covers vendor-specific acceleration across several GPU vendors. Community users confirm CUDA acceleration delivers real speedups, though older reports note limits such as a ~2x gain on a 4090 and a GPU layer cap, and another user observes the project aims to support 'any computation device'. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the per-vendor backends (only a single README bullet is in evidence), and hands-on corroboration for AMD/HIP or MUSA performance.
